# Problem brief: agents bypass planning alternatives

## Problem statement

Solution-bearing FRs are planned from whatever the author's loaded
context resembles: shell in the diff produces shell solutions, hooks in
context produce hook solutions. The house framework is never proposed
despite being available. The cost of the unexplored alternative was
priced at ~3 hours, 5 review rounds, and a 601-line hook in one
witnessed arc.

## Classification

judgement/analysis/generation

## Constraints

- The planning phase must gain input closure comparable to the judge,
  review, and author routes.
- No daemon; a blocking run measured in minutes.
- Cheap pinned model; pennies per run.
- Output must preserve planner disagreement rather than voting it away.

## Witnessed incidents

- 2026-08-25: a 13-AC enumerative grammar shipped without OS permissions
  ever being considered; the operator supplied the winning class as a
  throwaway remark.
- 2026-08-25: the instrument for this moment existed in the repo and had
  never been fired at a real FR.
